recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆顆粒球，核只分成兩個圓形葉、中間細橋相連（像夾鼻眼鏡，pince-nez），染色質非常粗糙緻密；這種假性 Pelger-Huët 核是顆粒球系發育不良的經典線索。
features: Markedly coarse, condensed chromatin in both lobes
Cytoplasm with fine granules, somewhat pale
Myelocyte at left with round nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm
Immature myeloid cells at the edges; RBCs with drying artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a neutrophil with a bilobed, pince-nez nucleus with two round lobes joined by a thin bridge and very coarsely clumped chromatin. Nearby are a myelocyte and other granulocytic precursors, and the red cells show drying artifact. The pseudo-Pelger-Huët nucleus is a feature of dysgranulopoiesis. In the absence of a hereditary Pelger-Huët anomaly or drug exposure, this supports a myelodysplastic process when present in at least 10% of granulocytes.

ddx.vs: The inherited LBR-related anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no cytopenias.
Identical morphology can occur with these drugs, and it is separated by medication history and resolution after withdrawal.
Band nuclei are curved and uniform in width without two round lobes connected by a thin filament.
